◧ QR code transfer

offline

The photo is split into consecutive QR codes. Point the other device's camera at the screen — silent and fully offline.

The sending device shows the codes, the receiving device scans them. Keep a distance of 20–40 cm.

ᛒ Bluetooth transfer

BLE

Send the photo over Bluetooth LE (Nordic UART) between two Web Bluetooth devices, or route the acoustic transfer to a Bluetooth speaker.

◭ NFC pairing

NDEF

Touch the phones back to back: the other one opens this page with the right role preselected.

≋ Sound check

1.5–2.3 kHz

Play the three SSTV calibration tones to verify the speaker path before a real transfer.
